moves.label: Quick Hana Jab
moves.description: Fast high Hana-Hana jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Short blooming-arm poke at upper-body height.

moves.label: Hana-Hana Twin Slap
moves.description: Slow mid twin assault with a long active fan of blooming arms.
moves.reason: Multiple arms bloom forward in a mid slap sequence.

moves.label: Seis Fleur Flip
moves.description: Quick mid multi-arm flip that ends Robin in a crouched recovery.
moves.reason: Multi-arm flipping motion has full-crouch end data.

moves.label: Hana-Hana Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with long active blooming-arm reach.
moves.reason: Extended arm bloom is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Cien Fleur Wheel
moves.description: Slow mid arm-wheel strike with a tiny active hit and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Circular bloom of arms spins around Robin.

moves.label: Low Fleur Feint
moves.description: Slow low feint with moderate active time from a grounded arm fan.
moves.reason: Low blooming-arm fan spreads near leg height.

moves.label: Low Clutch Sweep
moves.description: Slow low knockdown sweep with extended active arm pressure.
moves.reason: Low arm spread is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Cien Fleur Crush
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown crush with extended active blooming-arm pressure.
moves.reason: Heavy multi-arm clutch is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Crouching Fleur Guard
moves.description: Quick mid crouching guard with extended active arm coverage.
moves.reason: Full-crouch sequence blooms arms around Robin.

moves.label: Crouch Fleur Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with extended active bloom and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch launcher ends in a rising arm bloom.

moves.label: Overdrive Hana Jab
moves.description: Steady high overdrive jab with a brief active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive command reuses the Hana-Hana jab.

moves.label: Clutch Aura Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown drive with long active blooming-arm pressure.
moves.reason: Aura drive blooms arms forward and is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: While-Rising Fleur Bloom
moves.description: Fast mid while-rising bloom with very long active arm coverage.
moves.reason: While-rising command blooms multiple arms upward.

moves.label: Ducking Hana Jab
moves.description: Steady high ducking jab with a brief active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab uses the same blooming-arm poke.

moves.label: Diagonal Fleur Launcher
moves.description: Fast mid launcher with long active blooming-arm pressure and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal launcher blooms arms upward and outward.

moves.label: Forward Hana Jab
moves.description: Quick mid forward jab with a tiny active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command uses a compact arm-bloom jab.

moves.label: Hana Rush Jab
moves.description: Steady high rush jab with a brief active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab reuses the Hana-Hana poke.

moves.label: Cien Fleur Burst
moves.description: Quick mid knockdown burst with very long active blooming-arm coverage.
moves.reason: Burst creates a row of arms and is authored as a knockdown.
